profile.summary: alex-ppg is a mid-level JavaScript developer specializing in Fastify plugin development and backend integrations. Their contributions focus on expanding Fastify’s plugin ecosystem with database, observability, and cloud storage integrations, alongside maintaining comprehensive documentation for community plugins. With a strong backend focus, their expertise includes async JavaScript patterns, middleware architectures, and Fastify’s plugin system. While primarily contributing to Fastify’s plugin catalog, their work demonstrates deep familiarity with Fastify’s core patterns and community standards.
